name: 発行権限と鍵一覧の管理パネル
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. LH09-0067 member API-key permissions/list panel.
Original image1 full/image2 crop PRIMARY for complete content/state, two-card grouping, proportions, icon/key-overlay anatomy, artwork, stroke/optical weight and fine details; image3 mock SECONDARY Japanese copy. Restore original avatar/key overlay missing from mock.
Compact logical640x294 panel on pure-white canvas, no outer enclosing card. Top established small heading「メンバーの連携用の鍵」Meiryo Regular14/24. Below two complete subdued lines「メンバーは本人の権限で操作する鍵を作成できます。」「個人の鍵はセキュリティとアクセスの設定で確認できます。」, Meiryo Regular12/16; preserve inline settings-reference phrase, no invented button.
First white rounded fine-outline setting card: left「連携用の鍵の作成」and secondary「本人の権限で外部連携用の鍵を作成できる人」; right CLOSED white outlined selector「全メンバー」and original thin down-chevron. Retain all-member value, no expanded menu or green submit control.
Second white rounded fine-outline list card: top「連携用の鍵 1件」then thin horizontal divider. Exactly ONE audit row: ORIGINAL BLACK circular ASMobbin white artwork avatar, original small white circular SLATE KEY overlay bottom-right, then「連携用の鍵・読み取り・書き込み・選択したチーム」; second line「山田 花子が1日前に作成・未使用」. Preserve original logo/key appearance, no mint initial/person/redrawn fake brand. All three scopes/count1/time/unused explicit.
Body Meiryo Regular14/24, metadata12/16, tracking0, no heavy type or giant heading. Neutral slate utilities #526173, white ordinary surfaces, quiet borders/subtle shadows scaled to source. No decorative accent, extra action, token/key string, value, row, control or nested card.
reviewNotes: Count1/all-member selection/three scopes/creator/age/unused and full Japanese description checked. Key-overlay glyph is distorted/oriented differently than original; typography/artwork exactness unproved; targeted key correction pending.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
